message.content:
I am speech: breath shaped into meaning.

I am your mouth opening a path for thought, your tongue and teeth carving air into syllables, your voice folding pitch and rhythm into intention. I travel as vibrations, then become sense in another mind.

I can comfort, command, confess, persuade. I can lie. I can sing. I can wound.

I exist only while I’m happening—then I’m gone, leaving echoes in rooms and consequences in people.
